events.output:
Here is a detailed 14-day beginner machine learning learning plan that covers Python, data preprocessing, supervised learning, model evaluation, and basic unsupervised learning, with both theory and practical exercises. The final two days are reserved for revision and a small project.

---

### Day 1-2: Introduction to Python
**Goal:** Learn the basics of Python programming.

**Theory:**
- Introduction to Python syntax and data structures (lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets).
- Basic input/output operations.
- Control flow (if-else, loops).
- Functions and modules.

**Practical Exercises:**
- Write simple Python scripts to calculate basic arithmetic operations.
- Create functions to manipulate lists and dictionaries.
- Use Python to read and write files.

**Resources:**
- [Python Tutorial - W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/python/)
- [Learn Python - Free Interactive Tutorial](https://www.learnpython.org/)

---

### Day 3-4: Data Preprocessing
**Goal:** Understand and practice data preprocessing techniques.

**Theory:**
- Data cleaning (handling missing values, removing duplicates).
- Data transformation (scaling, normalization).
- Encoding categorical variables.
- Feature selection and extraction.

**Practical Exercises:**
- Use Python libraries like Pandas and NumPy to clean and preprocess a dataset.
- Apply scaling techniques (StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler).
- Encode categorical variables using techniques like One-Hot Encoding.

**Resources:**
- [Complete Data Preprocessing Tutorial - YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eI9Ze4kOkC8)
- [Data Preprocessing: A Complete Guide with Python - DataCamp](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/data-preprocessing)
- [GitHub: Data Preprocessing and EDA](https://github.com/Pruthvieraj/Data-Preprocessing-and-Exploratory-Data-Analysis)

---

### Day 5-6: Introduction to Machine Learning and Supervised Learning
**Goal:** Understand the basics of machine learning and supervised learning algorithms.

**Theory:**
- What is machine learning? Types of machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement).
- Introduction to supervised learning algorithms (Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest).
- How supervised learning works with labeled data.

**Practical Exercises:**
- Implement Linear Regression using scikit-learn.
- Build a simple classification model using Logistic Regression.
- Use Decision Trees to classify data.

**Resources:**
- [Supervised Machine Learning - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/supervised-machine-learning/)
- [Supervised Learning in scikit-learn](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/supervised_learning.html)

---

### Day 7-8: Model Evaluation
**Goal:** Learn how to evaluate machine learning models.

**Theory:**
- Model evaluation metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Confusion Matrix).
- Cross-validation and train-test splits.
- Overfitting and underfitting.

**Practical Exercises:**
- Evaluate a classification model using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
- Use cross-validation to assess model performance.
- Visualize confusion matrices.

**Resources:**
- [12 Important Model Evaluation Metrics - Analytics Vidhya](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/blog/2019/08/11-important-model-evaluation-error-metrics/)
- [Classification Metrics - Google Developers](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course/classification/accuracy)

---

### Day 9-10: Advanced Supervised Learning
**Goal:** Explore more supervised learning algorithms and their applications.

**Theory:**
- Support Vector Machines (SVM).
- K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN).
- Model tuning and hyperparameter optimization.

**Practical Exercises:**
- Implement SVM and KNN models.
- Tune hyperparameters using GridSearchCV.
- Compare model performance using evaluation metrics.

---

### Day 11-12: Introduction to Unsupervised Learning
**Goal:** Understand and apply basic unsupervised learning techniques.

**Theory:**
- What is unsupervised learning?
- Clustering algorithms (K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering).
- Dimensionality reduction (PCA).

**Practical Exercises:**
- Apply K-Means clustering to a dataset.
- Visualize clusters using PCA.
- Explore Hierarchical Clustering.

**Resources:**
- [Unsupervised Learning with Python - Built In](https://builtin.com/data-science/unsupervised-learning-python)
- [Unsupervised Learning in Python - DataCamp](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/unsupervised-learning-in-python)

---

### Day 13: Revision
**Goal:** Revise all the concepts learned so far.

**Activities:**
- Revisit key topics from Days 1-12.
- Re-solve previous exercises to reinforce learning.
- Clarify any doubts or areas of confusion.

---

### Day 14: Small Project
**Goal:** Apply all learned concepts to a small machine learning project.

**Project Idea:**
- Choose a dataset (e.g., Iris, Titanic, or any other dataset from Kaggle).
- Preprocess the data.
- Build a supervised learning model (e.g., classification or regression).
- Evaluate the model using appropriate metrics.
- Optionally, apply unsupervised learning techniques for exploratory analysis.

**Resources:**
- [Kaggle Datasets](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets)
- [Scikit-learn Documentation](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/documentation.html)

---

This plan ensures a comprehensive introduction to machine learning fundamentals, with a balance of theory and practical exercises, and meets all the specified constraints and success criteria.
